propositions: Bug tickets lack metadata on which detection channel (canary, CI, review bot, human audit, user report) discovered them, preventing trend analysis on detection escape rates.

REBAR_DETECTED_BY environment variable set by automated filers must be read at the ticket creation convergence point (composer.create_core) and stamped on all ingress paths (CLI, library, MCP) without requiring explicit user entry.
Optional --detected-by CLI flag and explicit function parameter must override the environment variable; absence of both leaves the field unset with no prompt or required behavior.

Normalization strips whitespace and lowercases the value; empty or whitespace-only input is treated as unset (field absent); any non-empty normalized token is stamped verbatim with no enum enforcement, allowing new channels without code changes.

process_create reducer must project detected_by into compiled state present-only, mirroring source_* blocks, such that events lacking the field reduce byte-identically to pre-change behavior (additivity proof).
Jira inbound CREATE events (apply_inbound_records.py path) intentionally bypass create_core and carry no detected_by to avoid misattributing the reconciler daemon's environment as the filer.
